text:
tara_finance: FYI PX Health invoice #8932 autopay failed — card declined by issuer after 3 attempts. customer says they updated card but still failing. needs payment path (wire vs ACH microdeposit).
finance-bot: [AUTOPAY] charge failed for invoice 8932: decline_code=05, attempts=3, next_retry=2026-03-29T07:00:00Z
samir_support: do we have a backup payment method on file?
morgan_billing: No backup. Customer tried new card in portal but got same decline. Tokenized card shows response 05 (do not honor).
ella_ops: Might be issuer-level block. Can we surface a one-click manual pay link + 24h grace?
tara_finance: Customer urgent, says they need service kept online. They asked if we can accept a wire today. Any objections to manual wire instruction?
morgan_billing: We can accept wire, but need finance approval and bank details. Also flag for tax/reseller paperwork if >$50k. This invoice is $12,400.
samir_support: I'll ask customer if they can do ACH microdeposit (takes 2-3 business days) or immediate wire. Replying now: "We can accept wire today — we will send instructions. Microdeposits take 2-3 business days."
ella_ops: If we send wire instructions, please include exact beneficiary name and account formatting to avoid errors. I'll prep a templated note.
tara_finance: Drafting wire instruction now. Please review before sending.
morgan_billing: Also add note: include invoice number in beneficiary reference or we won't match automatically.
ella_ops: Wire instruction template:
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: FirstCloud Bank (US)
Routing/ABA: 111000025
Account: 9876543210
SWIFT: FCBKUS33
Reference: INV-8932 / Company name
Contact for confirmation: settlements@redwood.com
```
ella_ops: Add this + require payment confirmation screenshot.
tara_finance: Sending to customer now with a short deadline: please confirm by EOB PST or we'll schedule retry and potential temporary service hold.
samir_support: Customer replied: "Will wire today, expect confirmation in ~3 hours." :thumbsup:
morgan_billing: Great — once we get funds post, apply to invoice and mark autopay method blocked. Follow up with customer to update payment method.
ops-oncall: Note — if wire fails routing, escalate to ops-oncall and include FedRef/trace.
finance-bot: [NOTE] created ticket FIN-4728 for manual wire processing and reconciliation.
tara_finance: Closing loop here once payment posts. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
